checkpoints.label: AV1 hidden-library graphics: installed source comparison, stock601
checkpoints.sourceNote: Source commit 601e62924ca31fb8e6a439958590887e1397afb0; EXE SHA-256 d2f8744bca973d97609ec821a653cc9a903d23d07e3d9065d160704f7e44c81e. Stock frozen source601e629 with current package assets; unmodified during the batch. Full two-runtime and source identities are retained in the external run manifest.
notes: Fresh installed final sourcef868ad7 versus frozen stock601e629. One warmup and three measured processes per variant; three paired rounds rotate measured order. AV1 1080p30/AAC stereo; 1280x720 visible canvas at96DPI; HubThenOpen with3s hub settle; 20.5s media alignment; 30s sampling; seven snapshots/run with visibility guards. Fresh runtime/profile per process; warm OS caches. Mean of seven snapshots then mean and range across three run means.

The final installed process averaged about149.790MiB private bytes and74.989MiB dedicated GPU memory. Paired candidate-minus-stock reductions were10.72,7.73 and12.26MiB private and16.18,14.04 and16.19MiB dedicated GPU. Resource categories overlap. Three pairs describe this AV1 workload; they are not confidence intervals.

The saved VLC3.0.24 AV1 private-memory observation is136.473MiB, so Aperture remains13.317MiB higher in that historical workload. This is not a fresh matched VLC session. CPU, decode/output equivalence, picture quality, cadence, audio continuity, dropped frames and significance were not measured here. No overall player win is claimed.
Sampling starts after20.5s and does not profile the15s device-retirement transition. Visible functional return checks passed separately. See evidence index for exact build, failures and limits.

playback-installed-retirement-av1-resour.label: Installed hidden-library graphics: fresh-source AV1 resource comparison
playback-installed-retirement-av1-resour.method: One warmup and three fresh measured processes per variant; HubThenOpen3s; AV11080p30/AAC stereo; actual1280x720 visible canvas at96DPI;20.5s playback alignment;30s observation with seven guarded snapshots per run. Fresh runtime and profile per process, warm OS cache. Compare frozen stock601e629 to clean installed sourcef868ad7; all eight calls must sample and close normally. Mean snapshots within runs; report all three run means and paired differences. Memory categories reported separately because they overlap. Scope is an observed resource comparison only; no CPU/VLC ranking, confidence interval, decoder/output quality equivalence, cadence/audio/drop or retirement-transition claim.
